description:
** THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE. QUOTES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED UNTIL THE REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) IS POSTED AT A LATER DATE. **

The Air Force intends to solicit and issue a sole-source contract to Trumpf Inc. under the authority of FAR 6.103-1(b) and 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) for the following:

76th CMXG requests parts needed to repair the Trumpf Laser. The requested equipment item descriptions/specifications are outlined below:

• Two (2) CABLE 24,0M (P/N: 358648)

• Two (2) CABLE 20M GERBER (P/N: 347682)

• One (1) SERVOMOTOR Z=ZX01+Y84 (P/N: 375100)

• One (1) SERVOMOTOR (P/N: 375099)

• One (1) MODULE 18/36 (P/N: 375450)

Contemplated contract details:

  • Firm-fixed price (FFP)
  • Commercial, Sole-Source Acquisition
  • FSC/PSC – 3438
  • NAICS – 333517
  • Size Standard – 500

Requirements for Award:
System for Award Management (SAM) is required to receive any award. Vendors can register electronically at https://sam.gov/content/home.
